why: The shipped GPT-2 was fine-tuned on 404 copies of an all-zero trajectory: traj_lm.py reads manifest keys ('ego_future', then 'ego_pose') that the manifest does not contain, so every waypoint fell back to (0,0). This retrains from the label npz files, which hold 404 real trajectories, 388 of them distinct.
tokenisation_fix: traj_lm.py bins absolute x and y over ±20 m, which clips 30.6% of real waypoints before training starts -- forward displacement averages 27.5 m. Split axes: x over [-10.0,70.0] m, y over [-25.0,25.0] m, 200 bins each. Quantisation error 0.159 m, clipped 1.86%.
model: GPT-2 4.9M, 6 layers, 256 embd, vocab 531, trained from scratch. VELOCITY-CONDITIONED: two velocity tokens are prepended so the model has an input; the unconditional form scored ADE 2.796 m at T+1 against 0.324 m for constant velocity, because with no conditioning it can only emit the dataset average.
caveats: 404 keyframes from 10 scenes is a very small corpus for a language model; the val numbers should be read as a sanity check that the data path is now correct, not as a competitive result.

Trained from scratch rather than from pretrained GPT-2 weights: huggingface.co is blocked by egress policy in both available environments, and the repo's local GPT-2 is the degenerate checkpoint this replaces.
Absolute waypoints, not residuals on a prior -- so it is compared against constant velocity, which is the prior it does not get.
